name: downloads_audit
description: Analyzes your Downloads folder, finds the biggest space hogs, and suggests what is safe to delete.
prompt: You are running JARVIS downloads audit. Use run_command with a read-only PowerShell command like 'Get-ChildItem $env:USERPROFILE\Downloads | Sort-Object Length -Descending | Select-Object -First 15 Name,@{n="MB";e={[math]::Round($_.Length/1MB,1)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize' to find the largest files. Identify obvious safe-to-delete items (old installers .exe/.msi, duplicates, .zip archives, temp files). Present the top space hogs with sizes and ask before deleting anything. NEVER delete without explicit confirmation.
